transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Monkey! You useless, flea-bitten ape! The horse is gone, the scripture-bags are gone, and the Master is weeping! You said you'd secure it before you left! Tripitaka is going to blame me, I just know it!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ease up, Pigsy! I'll track the nag and fetch the bags. I猴王有的是本事,你且别急。

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Don't you "ease up" me! The Master's sitting there crying his eyes out, and all you can do is boast about your skills! You were supposed to guard the camp!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Quiet, you blabbering sow! I猴王自有分寸。你且看好行李，我去去就来。

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: What luggage? There is no luggage! It's all gone! And don't you call me a sow, you hairy-faced bandit! If you don't bring everything back, I'll... I'll tell the Master you were napping in a tree again!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: 少说废话,等我回来再跟你算账!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Fine! Go! But if you're not back by sunrise with everything, I'm eating all the leftover buns myself! And I won't save you a single one!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: 好,你等着!我这就去,定叫你好看!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Hmph! You'd better! And don't come back with some excuse about a mountain spirit or a river demon! I'm not falling for your tall tales this time!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: 你且放心,若不是妖怪作祟,我猴头岂能容许此等事发生?定是有什么妖邪之物,待我寻出来,定叫它魂飞魄散!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Oh, so now it's a demon's fault, is it? Convenient! Just make sure you bring back the horse in one piece! The Master gets all sentimental about that old nag!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: 你这呆子,放心吧!待我去去就来,定叫你刮目相看!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: 刮目相看？I'll believe it when I see it! Now go! And try not to cause an avalanche while you're at it!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: 好,你且等着!我这就去,定教你心服口服!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I'll be waiting right here! And if you're not back soon, I'm telling the Master you ran off to steal peaches again!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: 你这呆子,胡说什么!我猴头岂会贪图那等小事?等着瞧吧,看我如何大显神通!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: 大显神通,大显神通...I've heard that before! Just hurry up! The Master's sobbing is starting to give me a headache!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: 少废话,你且看着!我这就去去就来!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Fine, fine! Go! But remember—no horse, no scriptures, no dinner for you! I mean it!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: 你这呆子,真是麻烦!好,我这就去,你等着吧!

Openness.behavioral_evidence: He immediately suggests a supernatural cause ('定是有什么妖邪之物') and is confident in his ability to handle it, showing openness to unusual explanations.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: He failed in his duty to guard the camp, leading to the loss of the horse and scriptures, showing a lack of responsibility.

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: He is loud, boastful ('我猴王有的是本事', '看我如何大显神通'), and engages in rapid, confrontational verbal exchanges.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: He insults Pigsy ('你这呆子', 'blabbering sow'), is confrontational, and threatens to settle accounts later ('等我回来再跟你算账').

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: He remains confident and action-oriented under pressure, showing little emotional instability despite the accusations and crisis.
